title: Bicol Express Keto Fried Rice
description: A keto twist on the classic filipino dish, this recipe uses coconut oil and no added sugars.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the express, yellow pepper, and zesty. Cook until the vegetables are tender.
Push the vegetables to one side of the pan.
Add coconut oil to the other side and scramble in the beaten eggs.
Mix the eggs with the vegetables.
Add the filipino and cook until heated through.
Optional: Add a fried egg on top.
